sources_note: 每日整合 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Meta 官方發布、TechCrunch、The Verge、Digiday、Adweek、量子位等一級媒體報道，聚焦香港及大灣區 digital agency 的實務需求。
sources_note_en: Daily synthesis from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta official releases, TechCrunch, The Verge, Digiday, Adweek, QbitAI and other tier-1 sources, curated for HK and Greater Bay Area digital agency practitioners.
thesis: 代理型 AI 全面接管執行層：廣告出價由 Google AI Max 決定、創意素材由 ChatGPT Images 自動生成、個人任務由 Meta Muse 代辦——AI 已不只輔助決策，而是直接代替人類行動。
thesis_en: Agentic AI is taking over execution across the board: Google AI Max controls ad bidding, ChatGPT Images auto-generates creatives, Meta Muse completes personal tasks — AI has shifted from decision support to direct action.
thesis_note: 今日 AI 大模型、廣告平台、創意工具三個版塊的消息同時指向同一趨勢：AI 代理正從「按指示行事」轉向「主動代替人類執行」。OpenAI 的數據顯示 AI 代理已達人類工作效率的 3.1 倍，Google AI Max 在無需廣告主操作的情況下自動接管搜尋廣告，Meta Muse 則開始代替用戶預訂行程和發送電郵。這標誌 AI 技術在廣告行銷領域進入「從工具到演員」的新階段，agency 需要審視自身在 AI 代理執行架構中的監督角色。
thesis_note_en: Today, three sections — AI models, ad platforms, and creative tools — all point to the same shift: AI agents are moving from 'act when instructed' to 'act autonomously on your behalf.' OpenAI's data shows AI agents now deliver 3.1x human productivity. Google AI Max auto-manages search ads without advertiser input. Meta Muse books travel and sends emails for users. This marks AI's transition from tool to actor in marketing — agencies need to rethink their supervisory role in an AI-agent execution architecture.

items.title: Meta 推出首個個人 AI 代理 Muse：可代用戶預訂行程、自主談判
items.title_en: Meta Launches First Personal AI Agent Muse: Books Travel, Negotiates Autonomously for Users
items.summary: Meta 於9月8日正式推出個人 AI 代理 Muse，可自主執行預訂行程、發送電郵、代為談判等日常任務，初期限美國18歲以上用戶使用，透過專屬應用程式或 WhatsApp 操作。
items.summary_en: Meta launched its first personal AI agent, Muse, on September 8 — autonomously booking travel, sending emails, and negotiating on users' behalf. Initially available in the US for users 18+ via a dedicated app or WhatsApp.
items.why: 標誌行銷生態從「問答 AI」跨入「行動 AI」時代，品牌觸達與互動邏輯將根本改變。
items.why_en: Signals a shift from conversational AI to action-taking AI — brand reach and engagement logic will fundamentally change.
highlights: Muse 可主動開啟瀏覽器、填寫表格並代表用戶進行談判，超越傳統問答式 AI 助手的能力範疇。
Zuckerberg 視 Muse 為 AI 超智能普及願景的第一步，代理將全天候為用戶執行任務，不受時間限制。
highlights_en: Muse can open browsers, fill forms, and negotiate on users' behalf — well beyond traditional Q&A AI assistants.
Zuckerberg sees Muse as the first step toward accessible AI superintelligence, with agents working 24/7 without time constraints.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI：AI 代理效能達人類的 3.1 倍，每週活躍用戶逾 10 億
items.title_en: OpenAI: AI Agents Achieve 3.1x Human Workday Efficiency, Serving Over 1 Billion Weekly Users
items.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar 發文披露，AI 代理在8月已達每研究員工作日產生 3.1 代理工作日的效能，旗下產品服務超過10億週活躍用戶與250萬家企業。GPT-6 Astra 已於9月3日推出並持續向企業開放。
items.summary_en: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar revealed that AI agents achieved 3.1 agent-workdays per researcher workday in August, with products now serving over 1 billion weekly active users and 2.5 million businesses. GPT-6 Astra launched September 3 and is rolling out to enterprises.
items.why: 首次以具體數字量化 AI 代理的生產力倍增效應，為企業評估 AI 投資回報率提供重要基準。
items.why_en: First hard numbers quantifying AI agent productivity multiplier — a benchmark for evaluating AI investment ROI.
highlights: AI 代理效能達人類 3.1 倍，企業採用後可大幅壓縮研究與內容生產周期。
GPT-6 Astra 已於9月3日推出，OpenAI 稱其為「全球最智能且最對齊的模型」，正逐步向企業擴大開放。
highlights_en: AI agents deliver 3.1x human workday efficiency, with potential to drastically cut research and content production cycles.
GPT-6 Astra launched September 3; OpenAI calls it the 'world's most intelligent and aligned model' and is progressively rolling it out to enterprises.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Chrome 改為雙週更新，AI 原生瀏覽器加速瓜分搜尋市場
items.title_en: Chrome Switches to 2-Week Release Cycle as AI-Native Browsers Accelerate Market Takeover
items.summary: TechCrunch 9月8日報道，Chrome 153 正式採用雙週更新周期，應對 AI 工具加速產生的安全漏洞。Brave、Opera Neon、Perplexity Comet 等 AI 原生瀏覽器同步蠶食 Chrome 市場份額。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch reported Chrome 153 officially switched to a 2-week release cycle to counter AI-accelerated security vulnerabilities. AI-native browsers including Brave, Opera Neon, and Perplexity Comet are gaining market share from Chrome.
items.why: AI 原生瀏覽器崛起加速搜尋行為碎片化，品牌需重新評估多平台內容可見度策略。
items.why_en: AI-native browsers are fragmenting search behavior — brands must reassess multi-platform content discoverability strategies.
highlights: Chrome 縮短至雙週更新，是自2021年由6週縮至4週後的再次提速，反映 AI 時代安全威脅的快速演變節奏。
Opera Neon、Perplexity Comet 等 AI 瀏覽器正動搖傳統搜尋引擎中心化格局，流量來源日趨分散，品牌 SEO 策略需同步擴展。
highlights_en: Chrome's 2-week cycle is its second acceleration since 2021, reflecting the faster pace of security threat evolution in the AI era.
AI browsers like Opera Neon and Perplexity Comet are eroding centralized search dominance, making traffic sources more fragmented and expanding the scope of brand SEO strategy.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google DeepMind 公布 AI Planet 加速器亞太新一屆 16 支入選團隊
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Names 16 APAC Teams for AI Planet Accelerator
items.summary: Google DeepMind 於9月7日公布亞太區 AI Planet Accelerator 新一屆16支入選團隊，涵蓋野生動物監測、農業及碳排量測等環境應用，是 Google 深化亞太區 AI 落地的重要信號。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced 16 teams for the APAC AI Planet Accelerator on September 7, covering wildlife monitoring, agriculture, and carbon measurement — signaling Google's push to deepen AI adoption across Asia-Pacific.
items.why: Google 亞太 AI 策略承諾明確，有助香港行銷人預判 Google AI 工具在區域的優先佈局方向。
items.why_en: Google's clear APAC AI investment signals where Google AI tools will be prioritized regionally — useful for HK marketers planning ahead.
highlights: 本屆加速器聚焦環境及農業 AI 應用，體現 Google 以 AI 推動可持續發展目標的品牌定位策略。
亞太區入選團隊跨越多個發展中市場，顯示 Google 積極擴大 AI 工具在區域的覆蓋範圍與品牌影響力。
highlights_en: The cohort focuses on environmental and agricultural AI, reflecting Google's brand strategy around AI for sustainability goals.
APAC teams span multiple developing markets, signaling Google's intent to scale AI tool coverage and brand influence across the region.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 法院拒絕強制分拆 Google 廣告業務，同步推出 Buyer Direct 繞過 AdX
items.title_en: Court Rejects Forced Google Ad Breakup; Google Launches Buyer Direct to Bypass AdX
items.summary: 美國法院否決強制分拆 Google AdX 的方案，改以行為補救措施回應壟斷問題。出版商反應分三派，部分人認為數據透明度要求比結構性分拆更具實際價值。Google 同時推出 Buyer Direct，允許大型廣告主繞過 AdX 直接購買。
items.summary_en: A US court rejected forced breakup of Google AdX, opting for behavioral remedies. Publishers split three ways. Google simultaneously launched Buyer Direct, letting large advertisers bypass AdX entirely within Google Ad Manager.
items.why: 程序化廣告環境短期維持現狀，廣告主採購策略毋需急變，惟需關注 Buyer Direct 帶來的競價格局演變。
items.why_en: Programmatic ad environment stays intact short-term; no urgent strategy shift, but Buyer Direct's impact on auction dynamics warrants monitoring.
highlights: 法院以行為補救措施取代結構性分拆，Google 拒絕 AdX 強制出售，反壟斷案進入執行細節談判階段。
Google 推出 Buyer Direct 功能，容許大型廣告主繞過 AdX 在 Google Ad Manager 直接購買廣告，市場整合進一步深化。
highlights_en: Court chose behavioral remedies over structural breakup; Google rejected forced AdX sale as the antitrust case moves to remedies negotiation.
Google launched Buyer Direct, letting large advertisers bypass AdX entirely to buy directly within Google Ad Manager, deepening market consolidation.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: AI 爬蟲流量按年暴增八成，電商再定向廣告受重創
items.title_en: AI Bot Traffic Surges 80% YoY, Corrupting E-Commerce Retargeting Pools
items.summary: Cloudflare 數據顯示逾半網路請求來自自動化代理。電商代理商報告客戶 bot 流量按年增八成，再定向受眾池遭污染，CPM 上漲逾兩成。部分品牌已轉向社交媒體、零售媒體及第一方數據應對。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare data shows over half of web requests now come from bots and AI agents. E-commerce agencies report ~80% YoY surge in bot traffic, corrupting retargeting pools and pushing CPMs up ~20%. Some brands are pivoting to social, retail media, and first-party data.
items.why: 再定向廣告效益急降，香港電商品牌需立即重審受眾策略，優先建立第一方數據資產。
items.why_en: Retargeting ROI declining fast — HK e-commerce brands must urgently reassess audience strategy and prioritize first-party data assets.
highlights: 電商代理商 GoFish 報告客戶 bot 流量按年增長約80%，再定向廣告表現自去年第四季起持續惡化。
AI 代理比傳統 bot 更難過濾，因其能完成加入購物車或表單填寫等行為，令標準過濾工具失效。
highlights_en: E-commerce agency GoFish reports ~80% YoY bot traffic increase, with retargeting performance deteriorating since Q4 last year.
AI agents defeat standard bot filters by completing cart additions and form sign-ups — unlike simple bots, they are indistinguishable from real users.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: FTC 起訴 Amazon 廣告競標造假，The Trade Desk 與日宣布裁員 15%
items.title_en: FTC Sues Amazon for Ad Auction Fraud; The Trade Desk Cuts 15% of Staff Same Day
items.summary: FTC 聯同22個州起訴 Amazon 以「軟性底價」機制造假競標，影響逾百萬廣告主。同日 The Trade Desk 宣布裁員約570人（約佔員工15%），預計成本達5,100萬美元。Google 反壟斷案與日以行為補救措施輕放。
items.summary_en: FTC and 22 state AGs sued Amazon for secretly inflating ad auction bids via a 'soft reserved price' mechanism, affecting over 1 million advertisers. The Trade Desk announced ~570 layoffs (15% of staff) at ~$51M cost the same day.
items.why: Amazon 廣告平台信任度受損，加上 TTD 裁員，廣告主需重審 DSP 組合及媒體預算分配。
items.why_en: Amazon ad platform credibility hit and TTD cutting staff — advertisers should review their DSP mix and media budget allocation.
highlights: FTC 指控 Amazon 自 2019 年起暗中引入「軟性底價」機制，至 2024 年已影響約八成相關競標及逾百萬廣告主。
The Trade Desk 裁員約 570 人，CEO Jeff Green 稱此為「下一成長階段」的準備，惟市場分析師對此解讀持審慎態度。
highlights_en: FTC alleges Amazon's 'soft reserved price' mechanism, active since 2019, affected ~80% of relevant auctions and over 1 million advertisers by 2024.
The Trade Desk cuts ~570 roles; CEO Jeff Green frames it as preparation for the company's 'next growth phase,' though market analysts remain cautious.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google AI Max 強制接管搜尋廣告，行銷人員批評透明度下降
items.title_en: Google AI Max Forcibly Takes Over Search Ads; Marketers Criticize Loss of Transparency
items.summary: Google 9月起強制將啟用廣泛比對或自動生成素材的搜尋廣告系列升級至 AI Max，行銷人員批評「AI 自行決定購買內容並降低透明度」。Google 稱可帶來平均7%轉換量提升，廣告主可選擇退出。
items.summary_en: Google auto-upgraded eligible Search campaigns to AI Max in September. Marketers criticize reduced transparency as 'AI decides what you buy.' Google claims average 7% conversion lift; advertisers can opt out without losing historical data.
items.why: 搜尋廣告控制權轉移至 AI，需立即審查 AI Max 設定、負面關鍵詞清單及 UTM 追蹤邏輯。
items.why_en: Search ad control has shifted to AI — immediately audit AI Max settings, negative keyword lists, and UTM tracking logic.
highlights: TAU Marketing Solutions CEO 批評 AI Max「自行決定廣告購買內容並降低透明度」，反映廣告主對自主控制能力喪失的深切憂慮。
Final URL 擴展可能將訪客導向與廣告設定不同的頁面，任何依賴廣告 URL 的 UTM 解析或 CMS 連接均可能靜默失效。
highlights_en: TAU Marketing Solutions CEO criticized AI Max for 'deciding what you buy and lowering transparency,' reflecting deep concern over loss of advertiser control.
Final URL expansion may route visitors to pages different from configured ad URLs, silently breaking UTM parsing and CMS data joins.
items.pattern: 追蹤技術衝擊：新增的 `segments.search_term_match_source` API 欄位將流量標記為「廣告主關鍵字」、「AI 廣泛匹配」或「無關鍵字」三類，現有報告管道需更新以捕捉這些維度。動態搜尋廣告的自動升級延至 2027 年 2 月，廣告主可提前自願遷移。
items.pattern_en: Tracking impact: The new `segments.search_term_match_source` API field labels traffic as 'advertiser keyword,' 'AI broad match,' or 'keywordless' — existing reporting pipelines need updating. DSA auto-upgrade delayed to February 2027; voluntary migration is available now.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: ChatGPT 廣告開放法律服務，早期每個潛在客戶成本僅為 Google 的四分之一
items.title_en: ChatGPT Ads Opens to Law Firms: Early CPL a Fraction of Google's Cost
items.summary: OpenAI 更新廣告政策，允許美國持牌律師事務所在 ChatGPT 投放廣告。早期數據顯示每個潛在客戶成本約 166 美元，遠低於 Google 廣告的每次點擊約 600 美元，廣告採用對話情境定向而非關鍵字。
items.summary_en: OpenAI updated its ad policy to permit US-licensed legal services advertising on ChatGPT. Early data shows ~$166 per lead vs. ~$600 per click on Google. Ads use conversational context targeting rather than keywords.
items.why: ChatGPT 廣告快速擴展行業類別，對多元化廣告渠道策略的品牌而言值得立即關注與測試。
items.why_en: ChatGPT ads expanding industry access rapidly — brands with multi-channel ad strategies should start monitoring and testing now.
highlights: 廣告代理商 ADSQUIRE 以約 2,000 美元廣告費獲取 12 個潛在客戶，每個約 166 美元，相較 Google 廣告每次點擊約 600 美元具明顯成本優勢。
ChatGPT 廣告採「對話情境定向」而非關鍵字定向，廣告主根據用戶正在討論的話題投放，代表全新的受眾接觸邏輯。
highlights_en: Agency ADSQUIRE spent ~$2,000 and got 12 leads at ~$166 each on ChatGPT vs. ~$600/click on Google — a significant early cost advantage.
ChatGPT uses conversational context targeting rather than keywords, with ads served based on what users are actively discussing — a fundamentally new engagement model.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: OpenAI 發布 ChatGPT Images 2.5：速度提升 50%，新增視覺標註局部編輯
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Images 2.5: 50% Faster with Visual Annotation Point-and-Edit
items.summary: OpenAI 於9月8日發布新一代圖像模型 ChatGPT Images 2.5，生成速度最高提升50%，新增草圖生成模式、視覺標註編輯（圈出指定區域局部修改）功能，API 提供 Flare 與 Sunburst 兩款子模型。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.5 on September 8, delivering up to 50% faster generation, new Sketch mode, and visual annotation point-and-edit. API variants Flare and Sunburst are now available.
items.why: 每週逾30億張圖像透過 ChatGPT 產出，速度與局部編輯功能直接提升廣告素材製作效率。
items.why_en: With 3B+ images generated weekly via ChatGPT, faster speed and precise regional editing directly cut creative production time for marketers.
highlights: 生成速度最高提升50%；新增草圖（Sketch）模式讓用戶手繪輪廓即可生成完整圖像，大幅降低概念圖製作門檻。
視覺標註編輯功能允許用戶圈出指定區域交由 AI 局部修改，其餘部分保持原樣，大幅降低重複修圖時間成本。
highlights_en: Generation speed improved by up to 50%; new Sketch mode lets users draw rough outlines and get complete AI-generated images, lowering the barrier for concept visuals.
Visual annotation editing lets users circle a specific area for targeted AI changes while keeping the rest of the image intact, dramatically cutting revision time.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra 引爆 3D 創作熱潮：43 分鐘建出含 26.7 萬棟建築的互動城市
items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra Sparks 3D Creation Frenzy: 267K-Building Interactive City Built in 43 Minutes
items.summary: 量子位9月8日報道，GPT-6 Astra 上線後用戶以 Python 腳本操控 Blender，43分鐘建出含26.7萬棟建築的互動式「迷你首爾」，消耗速度過快迫使 OpenAI 緊急重置所有用戶配額。
items.summary_en: QbitAI reported on September 8 that GPT-6 Astra triggered a 3D creation frenzy — users built a 267,000-building interactive 'mini Seoul' in 43 minutes via Python + Blender, forcing OpenAI to emergency-reset all user token quotas.
items.why: GPT-6 的 3D 生成能力展示 AI 在品牌虛擬場景與互動廣告方面的巨大潛力。
items.why_en: GPT-6's 3D generation capability previews AI's potential for branded virtual environments and interactive advertising experiences.
highlights: 用戶利用 GPT-6 Astra 以 Python 腳本操控 Blender，43分鐘完成含約26.7萬棟建築模型的互動式「迷你首爾」。
OpenAI 因用量激增緊急重置全體用戶配額，社群甚至出現專門追蹤重置時間的第三方網站，反映需求遠超預期。
highlights_en: A user built an interactive 'mini Seoul' with ~267,000 building models in 43 minutes using GPT-6 Astra controlling Blender via Python scripts.
OpenAI issued an emergency token quota reset due to surging usage; the community built third-party sites to track reset timing, reflecting demand far beyond expectations.

items.title: 可靈 AI 發布 2026 年十大 AI 影片模型對比：Kling 3.0 在角色一致性與原生音訊勝出
items.title_en: Kling AI Publishes 2026 AI Video Model Comparison: Kling 3.0 Leads on Character Consistency and Native Audio
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方於9月7日發布報告，對比 Kling 3.0、Google Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5 等十款主流 AI 影片模型，評測動作流暢度、角色一致性、原生音訊及多鏡頭敘事等維度。
items.summary_en: Kling AI published a comparison of 10 leading AI video models on September 7, including Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, and Runway Gen-4.5, evaluated on motion quality, character consistency, native audio, and multi-shot storytelling.
items.why: 提供 AI 影片工具選型的直接參考，幫助 agency 快速決策客戶提案的工具組合。
items.why_en: Direct benchmark for AI video tool selection, helping agencies quickly decide on tool combinations for client pitches and production planning.
highlights: Kling 3.0 在角色一致性、原生音訊同步及 4K 輸出方面表現領先，並支援多鏡頭分鏡圖參考生成。
可靈 API 將於9月15日起下線119款舊版特效模板及虛擬試衣功能，使用舊版 API 的開發者須於截止日前遷移至 Image 3.0 及 3.0 Omni。
highlights_en: Kling 3.0 leads in character consistency, native audio sync, and 4K output; supports multi-shot storyboard reference generation.
Kling API retires 119 legacy effect templates and Virtual Try-On on September 15; developers using the old API must migrate to Image 3.0/3.0 Omni before the deadline.

items.title: Meta Connect 2026 確認 9 月 23-24 日：預告 Ray-Ban AI 眼鏡與廣告自動化新動態
items.title_en: Meta Connect 2026 Confirmed for Sept 23–24: Ray-Ban AI Glasses and Ad Automation Updates Teased
items.summary: Meta 正式確認 Connect 大會於9月23-24日在加州門洛帕克舉行，Zuckerberg 預告新款 Ray-Ban AI 智能眼鏡，預計同步公布 Llama 模型及廣告自動化最新進展。Meta 已於9月起移除廣告手動版位控制選項。
items.summary_en: Meta confirmed Connect 2026 for September 23–24 in Menlo Park. Zuckerberg teased new Ray-Ban AI smart glasses; Llama model and ad automation announcements expected. Meta already removed manual ad placement controls in September.
items.why: Meta 廣告自動化進程直接影響 agency Q4 投放策略，Connect 公告值得提前部署應對方案。
items.why_en: Meta's ad automation roadmap directly shapes Q4 2026 campaign strategy — plan responses to Connect announcements in advance.
highlights: Meta Connect 2026 將聚焦下一代 Ray-Ban AI 眼鏡、Llama 模型更新及 Quest VR 頭顯，開發者專場設於第二日。
Meta 已於9月起移除廣告手動版位控制選項，改以 AI 主導廣告排期，廣告主現只能透過廣告組合層設定影響版位優先順序。
highlights_en: Meta Connect 2026 will focus on next-gen Ray-Ban AI glasses, Llama model updates, and Quest VR; developer sessions on Day 2.
Meta removed manual ad placement controls in September, replacing them with AI-driven scheduling; advertisers can now only influence placement priority at the ad set level.

items.title: 代理商競相建立 AI 代理審計機制，防止廣告開支失控
items.title_en: Agencies Build AI Agent Audit Frameworks to Prevent Runaway Ad Spend
items.summary: Gartner 指六成企業因 AI 使用缺乏管控而出現成本超支。Rise、Brainlabs、Dept、PMG 等代理商已自建決策記錄、配額上限及模型選擇分層等審計機制，防止 AI 代理超支失控。
items.summary_en: Gartner warns 60% of AI-deploying companies face cost overruns. Agencies including Rise, Brainlabs, Dept, and PMG built audit layers with decision logs, token caps, and model tiering to keep AI agents from overspending.
items.why: 客戶需主動向代理商查詢 AI 代理的成本管控機制，避免承擔不明超支風險。
items.why_en: Clients should proactively ask agencies about AI agent cost governance mechanisms to avoid absorbing unexpected overruns.
highlights: Dept 員工曾單日消耗150萬個 Token，促使公司建立「AI 閘道」，移除員工自行選擇 AI 模型的選項，統一由系統管控。
Gartner 調查顯示56%的企業在缺乏明確 AI 使用政策的情況下部署 AI，根本原因是員工「未有為任務選擇合適模型」，導致成本失控。
highlights_en: A Dept staffer burned 1.5M tokens in a single day, prompting the agency to build an 'AI gateway' removing individual model selection and centralizing control.
Gartner found 56% of companies deploy AI without clear usage policies; root cause identified as staff 'not choosing the right model for the task,' leading to cost overruns.

items.title: AI 編程代理 Cognition 估值達 480 億美元，客戶包括賓士與 NASA
items.title_en: AI Coding Agent Startup Cognition Hits $48B Valuation; Clients Include Mercedes-Benz and NASA
items.summary: TechCrunch 9月8日報道，Cognition 獲 a16z 領投完成20億美元融資，估值達480億美元，四個月內由260億美元躍升。年化收入從4.92億攀升至9億美元，客戶包括賓士、NASA 及高盛。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch reported September 8 that Cognition raised $2B led by a16z at a $48B valuation — up from $26B in four months. Annual run-rate revenue jumped from $492M to $900M, with clients including Mercedes-Benz, NASA, and Goldman Sachs.
items.why: 頂級企業大規模採用 AI 自動化工具，AI 代理市場高速擴張，agency 的技術服務定價面臨新壓力。
items.why_en: Enterprise-scale AI automation adoption signals rapid market expansion — agencies face growing pricing pressure on technical services.
highlights: Cognition 估值四個月內由260億美元躍升至480億美元，反映市場對 AI 代理類工具持極高信心。
公司正自訓練模型以減少對 OpenAI 與 Anthropic API 的依賴，反映企業級 AI 戰略走向垂直整合。
highlights_en: Cognition's valuation jumped from $26B to $48B in just four months, reflecting surging investor confidence in AI agent tools.
The company is training its own models to reduce reliance on OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, reflecting a vertical integration trend in enterprise AI strategy.

items.title: 物理 AI 公司深度智控獲寧德時代與沙特阿美投資，三個月內完成三輪融資
items.title_en: Physical AI Firm DeepCtrls Closes Three Rounds in Three Months, Backed by CATL and Saudi Aramco
items.summary: 深度智控於9月8日宣布完成 B+ 輪億元級融資，由寧德時代領投、沙特阿美創投跟投，三個月內完成三輪融資，加速構建 AI 算力與能源底座。
items.summary_en: Chinese physical AI startup DeepCtrls announced a B+ round of hundreds of millions RMB on September 8, led by CATL with Aramco Ventures participating — completing three funding rounds in three months.
items.why: 資本正快速湧入物理 AI 賽道，對工業與供應鏈有 AI 應用需求的品牌而言，這是值得追蹤的長線投資趨勢。
items.why_en: Capital is flowing rapidly into physical AI — a long-term investment trend worth tracking for brands with industrial or supply chain AI application needs.
highlights: 深度智控的 PhyAI 引擎可令 AI 在真實物理環境中運作，已服務全球數百家企業客戶。
CEO 表示 AI 發展下半場正從「數字世界的思考」轉向「物理世界的控制」，算力與能源是兩大核心支柱。
highlights_en: DeepCtrls' PhyAI engine enables AI to operate in real physical environments, already serving hundreds of enterprise clients globally.
CEO states the next era of AI shifts from 'thinking in digital worlds' to 'controlling the physical world,' with compute and energy as core pillars.

items.title: Runway 正式推出 Adobe Premiere Pro 與 After Effects 原生插件
items.title_en: Runway Launches Native Plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects
items.summary: Runway AI 於9月8日發布 Premiere Pro 與 After Effects 原生插件，創作者可直接在時間軸內生成影片、重新渲染片段及進行 HDR 轉換，無須離開 Adobe 工作流程。插件免費下載，生成內容消耗現有 Runway 帳戶積分。
items.summary_en: Runway AI launched native plugins for Premiere Pro and After Effects on September 8, enabling video generation, clip re-rendering, and HDR conversion directly within the Adobe timeline. Free to download; generation uses existing Runway credits.
items.why: AI 影片生成正式融入行業標準剪輯工具，廣告影片製作門檻大幅降低，今日即可試用。
items.why_en: AI video generation is now built into industry-standard editing tools — dramatically lowering the barrier for ad video production. Try it today.
highlights: 生成內容直接落在時間軸播放頭位置即時可剪輯，無須在應用程式間切換，大幅提升廣告素材製作流暢度。
Edit Studio 功能允許選取現有片段交由 Aleph 2 模型重新渲染，保持原有時長，適合廣告素材快速改版。
插件免費下載（macOS 與 Windows），生成內容消耗現有 Runway 帳戶積分，無需額外訂閱費用。
highlights_en: Generated content lands at the playhead in the timeline, ready to trim immediately — no switching between apps, keeping the creative workflow fluid.
Edit Studio lets you select an existing clip and have Aleph 2 re-render it at the same duration — ideal for fast ad creative versioning.
Free to download for macOS and Windows; generation uses existing Runway credits with no additional subscription required.

items.title: Adobe Firefly 新增 Voice Cuts：AI 以配音自動排列畫面生成影片初稿
items.title_en: Adobe Firefly Adds Voice Cuts: AI Auto-Assembles Visuals Around Your Voiceover
items.summary: Adobe Firefly 更新 Voice Cuts 工作流程，用戶提供配音稿後，AI 自動挑選並排列相關視覺素材生成可編輯初稿影片。配合 ElevenLabs 語音合成支援多語言，大幅壓縮廣告影片製作周期。新增 Banners at Scale 廣告模板。
items.summary_en: Adobe Firefly updated Voice Cuts, allowing AI to auto-arrange visuals around a voiceover to generate an editable first-draft video. Supports multiple languages via ElevenLabs. New Banners at Scale and Product Assets ad templates added.
items.why: 從文案到影片初稿全流程自動化，社交廣告影片製作效率倍增，適合快速產出多語言廣告版本。
items.why_en: From copy to video draft, fully automated — multiplied efficiency for social ad production, ideal for rapid multilingual versioning.
highlights: Voice Cuts 以配音為骨架，AI 自動編排視覺素材生成可編輯初稿，創作者只需精修而非從零開始。
Generate Speech 功能支援多語言與多口音，可自訂語速與音調，由 ElevenLabs 提供底層支援。
新增 Banners at Scale 與 Product Assets 廣告模板，直接針對數位廣告素材批量生產場景設計。
highlights_en: Voice Cuts uses voiceover as a scaffold; AI arranges visuals into an editable first-draft so creators refine rather than start from scratch.
Generate Speech supports multiple languages and accents with customizable speed and pitch, powered by ElevenLabs.
New Banners at Scale and Product Assets templates are designed specifically for digital ad creative batch production workflows.

items.title: Meta Ads Manager 推出創意多樣性評分，AI 代理獲授權直讀廣告帳戶
items.title_en: Meta Ads Manager Introduces Creative Diversity Scoring; Meta AI Gets Access to Read Ad Accounts
items.summary: Meta 廣告管理工具推出創意多樣性評分（低/中/高），反映廣告組合是否足夠多元以提升競拍競爭力。Meta AI 同步獲授權直接讀取廣告帳戶數據，9月中旬起 AI Developer Assistant 成為主要開發者支援渠道。（來源待核實）
items.summary_en: Meta Ads Manager introduced Creative Diversity Scoring (Low/Medium/High) to flag insufficient creative variety. Meta AI can now directly read ad account data and proactively surface optimizations. AI Developer Assistant becomes primary dev support from mid-September. (Source to be verified)
items.why: 創意多樣性評分直接影響廣告投放表現，來源待核實，建議登入廣告帳戶確認是否已見到此評分指標。
items.why_en: Creative diversity score directly impacts ad delivery — source pending verification, check your Ads Manager to confirm if this scoring metric has appeared.
highlights: 創意多樣性評分顯示廣告系列的素材組合是否足夠多元，評分低者在競拍中競爭力下降，需增加素材類型。
Meta AI 現可直接讀取廣告帳戶數據並主動提供優化建議，廣告管理工具操作模式將趨向 AI 對話式互動。
highlights_en: Creative Diversity Scoring shows whether a campaign's creative mix is broad enough for competitive auction performance — low scores require adding creative variety.
Meta AI can now directly read ad account data and proactively surface optimization suggestions, shifting Ads Manager interaction toward AI-driven conversation.
items.source: Meta Ads 更新（來源待核實）
